data.name: KlimaDAO
data.description: KlimaDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization building blockchain-based infrastructure for tokenized carbon markets, operating the Carbonmark marketplace and the KLIMA token on Polygon/Base. It aggregates and facilitates trading/retirement of voluntary carbon credits (predominantly avoidance credits, with some removal credits) rather than physically removing CO2 itself.
